rationale: Operator choice 2026-11-13 through the decision rubric. F1 is exploitable only when a maintainer runs execute on the outsider's issue, and the interim rule forbids that here; C1 needs the gate on, and it stays off until AISDLC-1265 to 1268 land. The containment gaps F2-F4 are the detail worth holding back, so they wait for the author gate (AISDLC-1269). Counter-argument considered: a public F1 task signposts the missing author check to attackers of adopters. It survives because the exposure exists without the task, adopters can only protect themselves once told, and the public route fixes it in days with full CI where a private fork has none. Filed: AISDLC-1269 (F1), AISDLC-1270 (C1).
